modules.heading: Our Team
modules.blurb: Our team brings diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experience to the table, along with a unified desire to see Latin America realize its full potential. We're committed to helping the region's innovators develop successful businesses that will create greater opportunity for the entire region.
modules.blurb_mobile: We bring passion, expertise and wide-ranging support to help founders navigate growth and reach their full potential.

team_member.title: Masayoshi Son
team_member.long_description:
Chairman & CEO, SoftBank Group Corp, Tokyo

A visionary entrepreneur and investor, Masa, Representative Director, Corporate Officer, Chairman & CEO of SoftBank Group Corp, likes to venture into unchartered territory. He was early in broadband, early in mobile, early in China, early in India, and early in AI, all with great success. We are bringing this same approach of being “early” to Latin America.

team_member.title: Alex Clavel
team_member.long_description:
CEO, SoftBank Investment Advisers, New York

Alex is Chief Executive Officer of the SoftBank Vision Funds. He joined SoftBank in 2015 in Tokyo and served previously as CEO of SoftBank Group International. Alex joined SoftBank after nearly 20 years at Morgan Stanley in investment banking in New York, Hong Kong, Shanghai, and Tokyo. Alex holds a degree in East Asian Studies from Princeton University and speaks Mandarin Chinese, French, and (conversational) Japanese.

team_member.title: Juan Franck
team_member.long_description:
Managing Partner, Portfolio Management, Mexico City

Juan Franck is a Managing Partner based in Mexico City, where he leads the Latin America Funds and heads the Global Asset Management Group. Prior to joining Softbank Investment Advisers in 2019, he led growth investments in Latin America for Temasek Holdings and worked in investment banking at Barclays Capital in New York. Juan holds an MBA from Harvard Business School and an Industrial Engineering degree from Instituto Tecnológico de Buenos Aires (ITBA).

data.title: Joaquin Perez Alati
data.long_description:
Head of Legal, Senior Counsel, Miami

Joaquin leads the negotiation of investments, divestments and other legal matters for the Latin America Funds and Vision Funds. He joined SoftBank in September 2021. Prior to that he worked at Sullivan & Cromwell LLP in New York City and at PAGBAM in Buenos Aires. He holds an L.L.M.
